findings.claim: The release-candidate pipeline is specified to decide Dart/Rust release inclusion before formally depending on the Dart and Rust/Tauri artifact work it must package or exclude.
findings.evidence: `v3-release-pipeline-rc` details require "Rust/Dart inclusion or explicit exclusion" but its dependencies are only `v3-package-module-contracts`, `v3-binding-singleton-contract`, and `v3-main-ci-baseline`; the Dart/Rust artifact-defining changes are `v3-dart-graph-riverpod` and `v3-tauri-mobile-plugin`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `v3-dart-graph-riverpod` and `v3-tauri-mobile-plugin` as dependencies of `v3-release-pipeline-rc`, or narrow the release-pipeline change to npm-only and move Dart/Rust inclusion/exclusion into a later cross-registry release workflow.

findings.claim: The conceptual docs change can be scheduled without the sync implementation it is required to document and test.
findings.evidence: `v3-docs-concepts-packages` says it will write tested guides for "sync" and "realtime batching", but its dependencies are only `v3-framework-neutral-core`, `v3-binding-singleton-contract`, and `v3-docs-foundation-brand`; it does not depend on `v3-sync-persistence-path`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `v3-sync-persistence-path` as a dependency of `v3-docs-concepts-packages` so sync/realtime documentation is based on the certified implementation and tests.

findings.claim: The Next.js example claims realtime behavior without depending on the plan's mandatory sync/realtime path.
findings.evidence: `v3-nextjs-app-router-example` details include "realtime client takeover", but its dependencies are only `v3-framework-neutral-core`, `v3-binding-singleton-contract`, and `v3-example-coverage-contract`; the deterministic realtime/offline path is handled by `v3-sync-persistence-path`.
findings.suggested_fix: Either add `v3-sync-persistence-path` as a dependency of `v3-nextjs-app-router-example` or remove realtime certification from the Next.js example and leave it to another example with the proper dependency.

findings.claim: The release contract includes KBD waypoint/project alias reconciliation that is not tied to any stated release goal.
findings.evidence: `v3-release-contract` details include "Reconcile the stale KBD waypoint/project aliases", while the goals cover production-ready 3.0 publication, examples, Flutter consolidation, machine-verifiable coverage, and Docusaurus documentation; no goal mentions KBD orchestration metadata.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove this from the release contract or explicitly justify it as a prerequisite for reproducible release governance.
